display_title: Song Yi Yeon, 50 Years Old, One Month After Divorce

native_title: 50歳サレ妻、離婚ホヤホヤにつき。
romanized_title: Song Yi Yeon, 50 Years Old, One Month After Divorce
description:
Song Yi-Yeon, who became a divorcee at age 50, enters the middle-aged dating market with nothing she knows how to do or wants to do. Reunited with her first love, first pleasure and attention, lost youth, successive betrayals, will she remain a remarried mother or a woman? "I want to be happy" For the first time in her life, she jumps into a typhoon
